hero-description.value: Professional opportunities in global commodity trading and operations.

section-1-body-1.value: AFGT employs professionals across trading, operations, logistics, risk management, and support functions. The company operates in 25 countries with offices in major trading hubs.

section-1-body-2.value: Employees work in collaborative teams focused on commodity markets, supply chain management, and institutional partnerships.

section-1-body-3.value: The company provides professional development programs, market training, and international exposure across different commodity sectors and geographic markets.

section-1-body-4.value: AFGT maintains workplace standards aligned with international labor practices and regional employment regulations.

questions-body.value: For inquiries about career opportunities, contact the Human Resources department.
